text:
emily: FYI — AvenueRetail pilot dropped ~52% yesterday after their procurement contact left. champion is still engaged but they paused automated calls.
zayd: Oof. dashboard shows request rate down, but no error surge. could be a governance hold from procurement.
rachel: quick check — integration heartbeats still green. no config drift in our envs. pulled last 48h: 
```
curl -s https://api.redwood.io/v1/usage/account/avenue | jq '.requests_last_48h'
# -> 1.2k (prev week 2.5k)
```
emily: Customer message (DM to our champion): "we've paused while procurement reviews vendor shortlist; shortlisted ModelStack and LLMWorks." :thinking_face: that looks like a competitive eval.
zayd: That phrasing is red flag. we need a quick rescue. can we offer a short extended pilot + a tailored cost comparison?
marco: Sales ok to approve a 10-day credit extension and 1-week dedicated test window (small capacity). Finance asked RevOps to log it.
revops-bot: ticket created: #8422  avenue_pilot_credit_extension. approver: marco.
emily: Good. i'll book a 30-min sync with new procurement lead + our champion. suggest demo focus: 1) audit of security & SSO to remove procurement blockers, 2) direct cost-per-unit comparison vs. ModelStack, 3) quick perf run on their sample dataset.
rachel: i'll run a quick perf baseline and prepare a one-pager on latency/cost + model quantization options. will include sample microbenchmarks and expected savings.
zayd: i'll draft a procurement-facing delta table (feature + SLA + cost) and include reference customers for compliance asks.
emily: Meeting set for Thu 4/10 09:00 PT. agenda and pre-read: https://redwood.internal/sales/avenue/procurement-pre-read (internal). can someone own meeting notes and next-step tasks?
marco: i'll own notes + pricing delta follow-up. will confirm credit amount in ticket.
emily: Action items recap: @marco confirm credit + capture in ticket #8422, @rachel perf baseline + one-pager, @zayd procurement delta table, i'll run the meeting and surface procurement blockers. aim to close within 7 business days.
zayd: adding a post-call bespoke eval offer: if they show a technical win with our perf baseline, propose a short canary Dedicated slot to demonstrate scale.
emily: perfect. thanks everyone.
